commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The chapter 25 composition defined its incidence flags as equality against five statistical reporting numbers from other chapters (e.g. entry_is_line_a = hts_number == "7202.11.10.00", a chapter 72 ferroalloy line), so membership concepts the cited sources define over line lists — the 9903.01.32 reciprocal annex exclusion, the 9903.01.33 §232 metals scope, the §301 China lists, §201 solar and §338 alcohol — were encoded as a single out-of-chapter exemplar line and could never hold for any chapter 25 entry.
triage.triage_notes: Diff has exactly two hunks: the module summary (generator version plus the new sentence declaring the five identifiers caller inputs) and the removal of the five derived rules entry_is_line_a..e with their proof atoms citing us/statute/hts/7202.11.10.00, 7601.10.30.00, 9506.62.40.40, 2203.00.00.30, 8541.42.00.10. Verified in the post-fix file that the flags are still referenced by downstream formulas (entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded = entry_is_line_a at line 1906, entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded = entry_is_line_b at 1923, china_section_301_component_rate's five-term sum at 2993-2997, section_232_aluminum_component_rate, section_338 chain, brazil IEEPA terms), so removing the local derivations changes what those rules compute rather than being a rename. The companion test ch25.test.yaml (same commit) converts entry_is_line_* from asserted outputs to declared inputs and rewrites the positive-coverage cases for entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded/metals_excluded from hts_number: 7202.11.10.00 / 7601.10.30.00 to entry_is_line_a/b: true, confirming the semantic change. tools/generate_schedule_compositions.py carries the rationale verbatim: "generated compositions must not derive them from the five hand-built witness HTS exemplars" (that file is other_files, not a module diff, so the quote above is taken from the PR body). Alternative kind considered: wrong_entity_or_scope (list membership encoded as one exemplar line); I chose untraceable_branch because the fix removes conditions whose proof atoms ground a chapter 25 module on other chapters' provisions. Caveat that keeps confidence below 0.8: the retained boilerplate sentence claims "changes no formula tokens, dates, inputs, proof atoms, or runtime values" and the maintainers frame this as a structural decoupling, though inputs, outputs and reachable branches demonstrably change. Provision text not resolved: the kind does not turn on statutory wording, only on which provisions the removed atoms cite.
triage.verifier_justification: In the pre-fix chapter 25 composition, the membership concepts were grounded on single out-of-chapter exemplar lines: `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded` (source "Chapter 99 U.S. note reciprocal annex exclusion list under heading 9903.01.32") had formula `entry_is_line_a`, and `entry_is_line_a` was the removed derived rule `hts_number == "7202.11.10.00"` — a chapter 72 ferroalloy statistical reporting number that no chapter 25 entry can ever match, so the exclusion (and likewise `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded`, the §301 slots in `china_section_301_component_rate`, the §122 and Brazil carve-outs) was false-by-construction for every line this module prices. Reading the cited provision through the pinned release (us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap, `us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-178` is the 9903.01.32 list header and page-180 of that same list enumerates 18 chapter-25 subheadings: 2504.10.10/.50, 2504.90.00, 2510.10.00/.20.00, 2511.10.10/.50, 2519.10.00, 2519.90.10/.20, 2524.90.00, 2529.21.00/.22.00, 2530.20.10/.20, 2530.90.10/.20/.80) shows the source defines the concept over a line list that includes chapter 25, so the encoded condition disagreed with the cited source and its proof atoms cited the wrong provision (a chapter 72 carbon-content excerpt). The fix removes those five hard-coded conditions and makes the flags caller inputs, i.e. it removes an ungrounded branch rather than adjusting a number, bound, or clause — untraceable_branch, not amount_mismatch, boundary_direction, or unrepresented_clause. This is a meaning change, not bookkeeping: the module stops asserting the false equivalence, so the "mechanical" reading fails even though the summary boilerplate still claims no runtime values changed.
triage.verifier_notes: Refutation attempts that failed: (1) "mechanical / plumbing" — the diff deletes five derived rules and their proof atoms, converting them to caller inputs, so the module's input surface and computed values change; the retained summary sentence "This deterministic RuleSpec serialization changes no formula tokens, dates, inputs, proof atoms, or runtime values" is stale boilerplate contradicted by the new sentence in the same summary ("The identifiers entry_is_line_a, ... are caller inputs supplied by entry preparation from incidence classification"). (2) "not_a_defect / new scope never claimed" — the module does claim these concepts: `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded`, `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` (source "HTS 9903.01.33 section 232 metals article scope") and `china_section_301_component_rate` exist, are cited to those sources, and are wired into `schedule_statutory_stack`; the source list demonstrably covers chapter 25 lines. The PR body independently characterizes the old scheme as wrong: "the witness's exemplar coupling, which round-2 evaluation showed unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins". Closest alternative kind is wrong_entity_or_scope (a list-membership population encoded as one line), but the fix removes the branch rather than widening a population, and the kind definition for untraceable_branch explicitly covers "formulas grounded on the wrong provision". Reviewer caveats: this is a partial repair — post-fix ch25 line 1950 still has `entry_is_energy_resource` (source "HTS 9903.01.13 energy and critical minerals article scope") encoded as `hts_number == "7202.11.10.00"`, the identical pattern, so the same defect class survives this commit; and the commit touches 100 generated chapter modules with byte-identical structure, so this case should be deduplicated against the other ch* modules in 2a6bdb01de.
